rows.grounds: compound describing vessels holding a prastha measure of grain
refers to the remaining locations not specified previously
injunctive ritual instruction to install the vessels

items.question: What kind of vessels must be installed in the remaining locations?
premises: The prior instruction specifies jars placed in rice heaps.
Other locations remain to be furnished with vessels.
Pots holding a prastha measure are designated for these locations.
items.inference: Therefore the remaining locations must receive pots holding a prastha measure.
uncertainties: The exact referent of itareṣu depends on the broader ritual layout.
items.plain_english: In the remaining places, one should place pots holding a prastha measure of grain.
